title: NXR Connectome (on-disk)
description: Structural connectome derived from fibers: a sparse vertex x vertex weight matrix W indexed to the subject's manifold mesh vertices, plus the largest-connected-component vertex indices. Lives under manifold/ because W is only valid against this store's mesh.

dims.nKeep: vertices in the largest connected component

registration.description: Fiber provenance string from tess_connectome, e.g. 'own:<comment>' (subject's own fibers) or 'default:HCP-1065' / 'default:HCP-1065 (registered)' (template fibers).

keep.description: Largest-CC vertex indices W is defined on.
